propositions: caused_by auto-derivation via file-level git blame is a fallback for attributed bugs lacking explicit caused_by edges and feeds metrics and escape-rate calculations

with 88 closed bugs carrying caused_by edges, the deriver reproduces 38 agreements, 6 disagreements, and 44 abstentions (50% fail-closed), leaving the true blame-derived proportion unbounded due to absent provenance markers

on 8 bugs with independently proven origins, the deriver scored zero correct, one confidently wrong-target, and seven abstained, with wrong answers occurring on unmet-obligation shapes where file-majority blame names the innocent party
lack of provenance field (derived vs explicit) on caused_by link events makes edge reliability uncomputable for consumers (metrics, escape-rate lenses, epic-close floor), answering decision (a)
shape-based deriver refinement is not implementable because defect shape is not observable to the blame mechanism; decision (b) is to preserve fail-closed status and mark derived edges instead
